definition: We exclude gains and losses on equity investments; amortization of acquired intangible assets; acquisition-related costs; severance costs (within personnel expense to realign our organizational structure and focus on areas that will drive higher long-term growth); lease consolidation costs (charge within general and administrative expense associated with the consolidation of certain leased office spaces); litigation provision (significant accruals for uncovered legal matters and additional accruals for the interchange multidistrict litigation covered by the U.S. retrospective responsibility plan).
